paragraphs.text: And in the third week in the second jubilee [64-70 A.M.] she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth [71-77 A.M.] she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth [78-84 A.M.] she gave birth to her daughter Âwân.
paragraphs.original: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሣልስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቅንአ፡ ቃየል፡ ለአቤል፡ እኁሁ፡ እስመ፡ ይሰዐር፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ አቤል፡ ወላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቃየል፡ ኢተሰዐረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē qadāmāwi sabuʿ śāləs ʾiyobēləwu qənʾa Qāyāl la-ʾAbēl ʾəḫuhu ʾəsma yəssaʿar ʾəgziʾ lāʿla maśwāʿta ʾAbēl wa-lāʿla maśwāʿta Qāyāl ʾi-tassaʿara

paragraphs.text: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee [99-105 A.M.], Cain slew Abel because (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not the offering of Cain. And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground complaining because he had slain him.
paragraphs.original: ወቀተሎ፡ በገዳም፡ ወዜንወት፡ ደሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ለቤዛ፡ ቅትለቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-qatalo ba-gadām wa-zēnnawat damu lāʿla mədr la-ʾəgziʾ la-bēzā qətlatu

paragraphs.text: And the Lord reproved Cain because of Abel, because he had slain him, and he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his cursed him upon the earth. And on this account it is written on the heavenly tables, 'Cursed is ,he who smites his neighbour treacherously, and let all who have seen and heard say, So the man who has seen and not declared (it), let him be accursed as the other.'
paragraphs.original: ወረገሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለቃየል፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ደም፡ ዘከውን፡ ቅቱለ፡ ወወሀቦ፡ ኪያሁ፡ በምድር፡ ዘይትገነይ፡ ወይውዕል፡ ይብሉ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ragagamo ʾəgziʾ la-Qāyāl ʾəm-nə mədr ʾəm-nə dam zakon qətula wa-wahabō kiyāhu ba-mədr za-yətgannay wa-yəwʿəl yəblu lāʿlēhu mədr

paragraphs.text: this reason we announce when we come before the Lord our God all the sin which is committed in on earth, and in light and in darkness, and everywhere. And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, [99-127 A.M] and in the fourth year of the fifth week [130 A.M.] they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said 'GOD has raised up a second seed unto us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.'
paragraphs.original: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ርግምት፡ ለዘ፡ ይዘብጥ፡ ካልኦ፡ በዕልው፡ ወይብሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ርእዩ፡ ወእለ፡ ሰምዑ፡ አሜን፡ ወብእሲ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ወኢዜነወ፡ ይኩን፡ ርጉመ፡ ከማሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾənta zəntu ṣəḥuf wəsta ṣəlāta samāy rəgəmət la-za yəzabbəṭ kāləʾo ba-ʿəlw wa-yəblu kwəlomu ʾəlla rəʾəyu wa-ʾəlla samʿu ʾāmēn wa-bəʾəsi za-rəʾəya wa-ʾi-zēnnawa yəkun rəgguma kamāhu

paragraphs.text: week [134-40 A.M.] he begat his daughter Azûrâ. And Cain took Âwân his sister to be his wife and she bare him Enoch at the close of the fourth jubilee. [190-196 A.M.] And in the first year of the first week of the fifth jubilee, [197 A.M.] houses were built on the earth, and Cain built a city, and called its name after the name of And Adam knew Eve his wife and she bare yet nine sons.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አንበረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለቃየል፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሎ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረከቦ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu ʾanbara lottu la-Qāyāl təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəqtəlo kwəlu zarakabō

paragraphs.text: the fifth week of the fifth jubilee [225-31 A.M.] Seth took Azûrâ his sister to be his wife, and in the fourth (year of the sixth week) [235 A.M.] she bare him Enos. He began to call on the name of the Lord on And in the seventh jubilee in the third week [309-15 A.M.] Enos took Nôâm his sister to be his wife, and she bare him a son in the third year of the fifth week, and he called his name Kenan.
paragraphs.original: ויהיו אדם ואשתו מתאבלים על הבל ארבעים שנה ובשנה הרביעית של השבוע השלישי של היובל השלישי שמח אדם וידע את אשתו ותלד לו בן ויקרא את שמו שת כי אמר הקים לנו אלהים זרע אחר תחת הבל כי הרגו קין
paragraphs.translit: wa-yihyū ʾĀdām wə-ʾištō mit-ʾabbəlīm ʿal Hebel ʾarbāʿīm šānāh ū-ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt šel ha-šābūaʿ ha-šəlīšī šel ha-yōbēl ha-šəlīšī śāmaḥ ʾĀdām wa-yēdaʿ ʾet ʾištō wa-tēled lō bēn wa-yiqrāʾ ʾet šəmō Šēt kī ʾāmar hēqīm lā-nū ʾĕlōhīm zeraʿ ʾaḥēr taḥat Hebel kī hărāḡō Qayin

paragraphs.text: And at the close of the eighth jubilee [325, 386-3992 A.M.] Kenan took Mûalêlêth his sister to be his wife, and she bare him a son in the ninth jubilee, in the first week in the third year of this week, [395 A.M] and he called his name And in the second week of the tenth jubilee [449-55 A.M.] Mahalalel took unto him to wife DinaH, the daughter of Barakiel the daughter of his father's brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, [461 A.M.] and he called his name Jared, for in his days the angels of the Lord descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.
paragraphs.original: ובשבוע החמישי של היובל החמישי הוליד את חנוך לאחיו וקרא את שמו אנוש כי אז החל בני האדם לקרוא בשם השם
paragraphs.translit: ū-ba-šābūaʿ ha-ḥămīšī šel ha-yōbēl ha-ḥămīšī hōlīd ʾet Ḥănōk lə-ʾāḥīw wə-qārāʾ ʾet šəmō ʾĔnōš kī ʾāz hēḥēl bənē hā-ʾādām li-qrōʾ bə-šēm ha-šēm

paragraphs.text: And in the eleventh jubilee [512-18 A.M.] Jared took to himself a wife, and her name was Baraka, the daughter of Râsûjâl, a daughter of his father's brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee, [522 A.M.] and she bare him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee, and he called his name Enoch.
paragraphs.original: ወወለደ፡ ቃየናንሰ፡ ለማላልኤል፡ ወወለደ፡ ማላልኤልሰ፡ ለያሬድ፡ ወወለደ፡ ያሬድሰ፡ ለሄኖክ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዐሥር፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada Qāyenānsa la-Malālʾel wa-walada Malālʾelsa la-Yāred wa-walada Yāredsa la-Henok ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-ʿaśr ʾiyobēləwu

paragraphs.text: And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to their separate months.
paragraphs.original: ወነሥአ፡ ቃየናን፡ ለሙአሌት፡ እኅቶ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በዓመት፡ ሣልስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ማላልኤል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾa Qāyenān la-Muʾalēt ʾəḫto la-rəʾəsu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-ʿāmat śāləs la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Malālʾel

paragraphs.text: And he was the first to write a testimony and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth, and recounted the weeks of the jubilees, and made known to them the days of the years, and set in order the months and recounted the Sabbaths of the years as we made (them), known to him.
paragraphs.original: ወማላልኤልሰ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዲናህ፡ ወለተ፡ ባራኬል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳምን፡ ሣልስ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳምን፡ ሳድስ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ያሬድ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወረዱ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እለ፡ ይሰመዩ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ከመ፡ ይምሀርዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Malālʾelsa naśʾa lottu Dināhə walatta Bārākēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-sāmən śāləs ba-sadus ʾiyobēləwu wa-waladat lottu walda ba-sāmən sādəsə ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Yāred ʾəsma ba-mawāʿəlihu waradu malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ lāʿla mədr ʾəlla yəssammayu Təguhānə kama yəmharəwomu la-daqiqa sabʾ wa-kama yəgbaru fətḥa wa-rətʿa diba mədr

paragraphs.text: And what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep, as it will happen to the children of men throughout their generations until the day of judgment; he saw and understood everything, and wrote his testimony, and placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.
paragraphs.original: ወባራካ፡ ወለተ፡ ራሱኤል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሄኖክ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Bārāka walatta Rāsuʾēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu lottu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat wa-samayō səmō Henok

paragraphs.text: And in the twelfth jubilee, [582-88] in the seventh week thereof, he took to himself a wife, and her name was Edna, the daughter of Danel, the daughter of his father's brother, and in the sixth year in this week [587 A.M.] she bare him a son and he called his name And he was moreover with the angels of God these six jubilees of years, and they showed him everything which is on earth and in the heavens, the rule of the sun, and he And he testified to the Watchers, who had sinned with the daughters of men; for these had begun to unite themselves, so as to be defiled, with the daughters of men, and testified against (them) all.
paragraphs.original: ወውእቱ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ እምነ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘተወልደ፡ ዘተምህረ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወአእምሮተ፡ ወጥበበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wəʾtu qadāmāwi ʾəm-nə daqiqa sabʾ za-wəsta mədr za-tawalda za-tamhəra ṣəḥfata wa-ʾaʾmərota wa-ṭəbaba

paragraphs.text: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.
paragraphs.original: ויכתוב את אתות השמים כסדר חדשיהם בספר למען ידעו בני האדם זמני השנים כסדרם בחדשיהם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiktōb ʾet ʾōtōt ha-šāmayim kə-sēder ḥodšēhem ba-sēper lə-maʿan yēdəʿū bənē hā-ʾādām zəmannē ha-šānīm kə-sidrām bə-ḥodšēhem

paragraphs.text: And on account of it (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.
paragraphs.original: ויהי הראשון אשר כתב עדות ויעד את בני האדם בדורות הארץ והוגד לו את שבועות היובלים בעשר ועשר וירא את חדשי הימים ויספרם ויקרא בשמותם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī hā-rīʾšōn ʾăšer kātab ʿēdūt wa-yāʿad ʾet bənē hā-ʾādām bə-dōrōt hā-ʾāreṣ wə-hūggad lō ʾet šəbūʿōt ha-yōbəlīm bə-ʿeśer wā-ʿeśer wa-yarʾ ʾet ḥodšē ha-yāmīm wa-yispərēm wa-yiqrāʾ bi-šmōtām

paragraphs.text: And he burnt the incense of (even) sweet spices acceptable before the Lord on the Mount. For the Lord has four places on the earth, the Garden of Eden, and the Mount of the East, and this mountain on which thou art this day, Mount Sinai, and Mount Zion (which) will be sanctified in the new creation for a sanctification of the earth; through it will the earth be sanctified from all (its) guilt and its uncleanness through- out the generations of the world.
paragraphs.original: ወሤመ፡ ዘመነ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዓመታት፡ በምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሤመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma zamana qadāmāwi la-ʿāmatāt ba-məsla malāʾəkta samāy śēma

paragraphs.text: And in the fourteenth jubilee [652 A.M.] Methuselah took unto himself a wife, Edna the daughter of Azrial, the daughter of his father's brother, in the third week, in the first year of this week, [701-7 A.M.] and he begat a son and called his name Lamech.
paragraphs.original: ויקח לו את עדני בת דניאל בת אחי אביו לאשה בשבוע הרביעי של היובל הזה בשנה הרביעית ותלד לו בן בשנה הרביעית של היובל הזה ויקרא את שמו מתושלח
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiqqaḥ lō ʾet ʿEdnī bat Dānīʾēl bat ʾăḥī ʾābīw lə-ʾiššāh ba-šābūaʿ hā-rəbīʿī šel ha-yōbēl ha-zeh ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt wa-tēled lō bēn ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt šel ha-yōbēl ha-zeh wa-yiqrāʾ ʾet šəmō Mətūšelaḥ

paragraphs.text: And in the fifteenth jubilee in the third week Lamech took to himself a wife, and her name was Betenos the daughter of Baraki'il, the daughter of his father's brother, and in this week she bare him a son and he called his name Noah, saying, 'This one will comfort me for my trouble and all my work, and for the ground which the Lord hath cursed.'
paragraphs.original: ወሀለወ፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመታት፡ ወአርአይዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወዘውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወጸሐፈ፡ ኵሎ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-hallawa məsla malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmatāt wa-ʾarʾayəwo kwəlo zawəsta mədr wa-zawəsta samāy kwənnānē ḍaḥay wa-ṣaḥafa kwəlo

paragraphs.text: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year [930 A.M.] thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወወጥረ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዓመታት፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-waṭra təʾəmərta samāy ba-kama śərʿata ʾawrāḫihomu wəsta maṣḥaf kama yāʾmərru daqiqa sabʾ gizē ʿāmatāt ba-kama śərʿatomu baba ʾawrāḫihomu

paragraphs.text: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: 'On the day that ye eat thereof ye shall die.' For this did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.
paragraphs.original: ውእቱ፡ ጸሐፈ፡ ስምዐ፡ ወሤሞ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ትውልዶሙ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኩናኔ፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ አበሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አንስት፡ እስመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወዘመው፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wəʾtu ṣaḥafa səmʿa wa-śēmo la-səmʿ lāʿla mədr lāʿla kwəlomu daqiqa sabʾ wa-lāʿla təwlədomu wa-ʾəmənna kwənnānē malāʾəkt ʾəlla ʾabasu məsla daqiqa ʾanəst ʾəsma qadāmi ʾəmuntu ḫadagu śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-zammawu məsla daqiqa mədr

paragraphs.text: At the close of this jubilee Cain was killed after him in the same year; for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house, and he was killed by its stones; for with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was righteous judgment.
paragraphs.original: ወምስለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመት፡ ወአንበረ፡ ስምዓ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፋት፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ትውልድ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-məsla kiyāhu kona Henok sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmat wa-ʾanbara səmʿa ba-wəsta maṣḥafāt lāʿla kwəlomu gəbra təwlədə ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē

paragraphs.text: For this reason it was ordained on the heavenly tablets: With the instrument with which a man kills his neighbour with the same shall he be killed; after the manner he wounded him, in like manner shall they deal with him.'
paragraphs.original: ወአዕረገ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኬደ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga maśwāʿta qadāmāwē lāʿla mədr ʿəḍa ḥəywat zawəsta bēta maqdas kēda samāy

paragraphs.text: And in the twenty-fifth [1205 A.M.] jubilee Noah took to himself a wife, and her name was `Emzârâ, the daughter of Râkê'êl, the daughter of his father's brother, in the first year in the fifth week [1207 A.M.]: and in the third year thereof she bare him Shem, in the fifth year thereof [1209 A.M.] she bare him Ham, and in the first year in the sixth week [1212 A.M.] she bare him Japheth.
paragraphs.original: ወሤሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ለትትዐውቅ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይዜምዉ፡ ወይትዐደው፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወከመ፡ ይምጻእ፡ ድልወት፡ ለቅቱል፡ ወዘይዜምዉ፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ይትኰነኑ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēmo ʾəgziʾ la-səmʿ lāʿla kwəlu təwlədə la-tətʿawwəq kwənnānē lāʿla kwəlomu ʾəlla yəzēmmuwə wa-yətʿaddawə śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-kama yəmṣāʾ dəlwat la-qətul wa-zayəzēmmuwə məsla ʾanəst yətkwannanu

paragraphs.text: The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament by R.H. Charles, Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1913 Scanned and Edited by Joshua Williams, Northwest Nazarene College
